'''Paus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] he was residing on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and investigating the death of [[Rikael Lysannis]], a member of the powerful family murdered by the [[Justicars' Brigade]]. Paus tried interviewing members of the Lysannis family but was stonewalled, which attributed to Justicar intimidation. Looking for a way to expose the Justicars, Paus asked a friendly passerby to recover the recording of Rikael's interrogation from one of the droids in the [[Justicars' Tower]].

==Behind the scenes==
Paus is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is voiced by [[Fred Tatasciore]].
